prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1268; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Our client was struck head-on in a low-speed collision and has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation, and we will provide supporting records as they become available. We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury and property damage limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including the claim file, photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any telematics or dash camera footage. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and provide a claim number so that we may coordinate the next steps promptly.
